title: Soul Snack #35: Can Healing Be Spontaneous?
excerpt: In this Soul Snack Gary explores the powerful question: Is healing spontaneous, or is it something we must choose and cultivate within ourselves?
bodyHtml:
In this Soul Snack Gary explores the powerful question: Is healing spontaneous, or is it something we must choose and cultivate within ourselves? With clarity and conviction, he emphasizes that healing is not a random gift from the universe – it is a conscious, personal responsibility. He guides listeners to understand how emotional awareness and spiritual commitment are essential steps to reclaiming power from fear-based parts of our personality.

Gary takes us deeper into the nature of grace, explaining how moments of lightness or peace may arrive spontaneously – but they are temporary. 

Real healing, he says, is about what we do when grace fades.

He offers a practical path for identifying when fear is active in our energy centers and invites us to respond with presence, not reactivity. Whether it’s anger, jealousy, or impatience, we have the power to recognize these patterns and choose not to act on them.

The solution to suffering lies in spiritual responsibility.

By developing mastery over fear-based reactions and choosing to respond with love, we move closer to creating authentic power and a life filled with meaning, vitality, and joy.

Please do not take anything that Gary or Linda share as true just because they say it. If it resonates with you, experiment with it in your life. If it doesn’t, let it go.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Snack:

  • (00:45) – Why healing isn’t spontaneous—and why it’s your responsibility to initiate it
  • (01:10) – What grace feels like, and why you can’t rely on it to sustain healing
  • (01:40) – How to identify fear-based parts of your personality through your body’s energy centers
  • (02:30) – Why choosing not to act on anger or fear is a spiritual act of power
  • (03:37) – Why healing is not just your duty—it’s your joy, your fulfillment, and your transformation

Explore your full potential, so you can give the gifts you were born to give. Your soul has been waiting for you to take this journey! Learn More Here.

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge:

Reflect on a time when a part of your personality—like anger, jealousy, or impatience—took control. Can you remember what it felt like in your body? How did it affect your decisions and relationships? Now, imagine facing a similar moment again and choosing instead to stay present and not act on that fear. Ask yourself: “What would it feel like to respond with love instead?” This is your opportunity to create authentic power.
